subject: Headcount triage: Q4 hiring constraints & urgent backfills
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount triage: Q4 hiring constraints & urgent backfills

Team —

Quick summary ahead of the QBR prep: finance has flagged a tighter headcount envelope for Q4 (guidance attached). We need leadership decisions this week on which reqs we approve, which get deferred, and which backfills are non-negotiable for customer commitments. My ask: please review the attached scenario workbook and the req tracker by EOD tomorrow.

Key points:
- We have ~12 open reqs across Eng, Platform, and CS that are not yet approved.
- Two urgent backfills for customer-facing SREs (REQ-2143, REQ-2147) — delaying these risks SLA credits.
- Suggested immediate freeze on non-customer-facing individual contributor hires for Q4 unless a clear revenue/ops dependency is provided.
- Proposed compromise: allow exceptions via a 1-page rationale + manager sign-off; leadership to triage exceptions.

Attachments: Q4_headcount_scenarios.xlsx, reqs_priority_tracker.csv (see sheets: baseline / constrained / customer-first).

I recommend we align on a single list for the QBR so People & Finance can finalize offers and budget allocations.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Growth & Go-to-Market
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount triage: Q4 hiring constraints & urgent backfills

Thanks for the summary. Short responses:

1) I support a targeted freeze on non-customer-facing IC hires for Q4.
2) Approve immediate backfill for REQ-2143 and REQ-2147 — operational risk too high otherwise.
3) For the remaining 10 reqs, we need a prioritization rubric: customer impact, time-to-value, critical-path for launches, and cross-team dependencies.

Please draft the rubric (one pager) and include the top 6 recommended approvals under the constrained scenario. I want a decision-ready list by tomorrow noon.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Ops & Revenue
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount triage: Q4 hiring constraints & urgent backfills

Agree with the freeze approach. Two clarifications:

- I need the two SRE backfills approved immediately (REQ-2143 & REQ-2147). Ops timeline: if we don't post this week we miss SRE coverage for the east-coast rotation starting 11/15.
- From Hiring: we can pause posting for lower-priority reqs but would like permission to convert one open IC req (REQ-2198) to a 6-month contractor role to maintain momentum on a high-impact project without committing headcount.

@TalentBridge: can you confirm contractor rate bands and availability (short list) by tomorrow?

V
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Headcount triage: Q4 hiring constraints & urgent backfills

Attached: reqs_priority_tracker.csv (updated), Q4_headcount_scenarios.xlsx (v2) and org-chart-compact.pdf.

Actionable items completed:
- Added prioritization rubric column to tracker (customer impact / revenue dependency / time-to-fill / cross-team risk).
- Flagged top 6 approvals under constrained scenario (see tracker: APPROVE_CONSTRAINED tab).
- Marked REQ-2198 as eligible for contractor conversion; added recommended contractor rate band.
- Added a short one-pager script for managers to submit exception rationales (folder link in the sheet).

Next steps:
- Markus: review the prioritized approvals list and confirm changes by 12:00pm today.
- Vanessa: confirm contractor go/no-go + TalentBridge rate confirmation.
- Mina/People: prepare offer hold/backfill timing for the approved reqs.

Thanks — files live in the QBR prep Drive folder.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Headcount triage: Q4 hiring constraints & urgent backfills

All — thanks for the quick turnaround and the updated tracker. Final decisions for QBR prep: 

1) Approve immediate posting and offers for REQ-2143 and REQ-2147 (SRE backfills). Hiring to run expedited process with top-of-funnel support from TalentBridge.
2) Approve the top 4 approvals under the constrained scenario (see APPROVE_CONSTRAINED tab).
3) Freeze the remaining non-customer-facing IC reqs for Q4. Exceptions will be handled via the one-page rationale + manager sign-off process; Lauren, please triage exceptions with Mina.
4) Approve converting REQ-2198 to a 6-month contractor; TalentBridge to return rate confirmation.

Please treat this as the leadership decision for the QBR snapshot; I will present these items at the QBR and align with Finance.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Growth & Go-to-Market
Redwood Inference
